Enables import/handling of regulated explosives, a gating step for integrating payloads into strike drones.
Multi-year regulatory visibility supports planning and potential contracts.
Aligns with domestic sourcing priorities; could aid DoD/LE procurement eligibility.
Timeline guidepost; investors can track execution toward production readiness.
Signals ambition for volume; if realized, could be revenue-scale, but not yet contracted.

This is an early-stage regulatory step in First Breach’s push from ammo components into attritable drones and integrated payloads. For this to be a larger catalyst, investors need evidence of platform approvals, funded contracts, and execution toward the 2027 scaling target.
